u0: This is the cleared, resting situation: no client is waiting to be served, the siren is silent, and no fallen food is awaiting immediate pickup. Every requirement raised so far has been handled. The agent simply waits for the next siren, client, or slip and responds when it happens; there is no permanent success state, so the episode continues until it ends.
u1: The siren is ringing and must eventually be switched off. No client is waiting to be served, and no fallen food needs immediate recovery. The only remaining requirement is to reach the siren switch and silence it; the agent may take time, but a new client or a food slip can add other requirements while it rings.
u2: The food has just slipped from the agent's hands, so the immediate requirement is to pick it up on the very next step. No client is waiting and the siren is not ringing. If the agent does not have food in hand again on that next step, the task fails permanently; otherwise the slip requirement is cleared.
u3: Food has slipped while the siren is ringing, so two requirements are active. The next step must be the pickup of the fallen food; missing that step fails the task. Only after the food is back in hand can the agent deal with the siren, which must eventually be switched off.
u4: A client is waiting to be served, and their order still needs to be completed. The siren is not ringing and no fallen food requires immediate recovery. The agent should take the order if necessary, get a portion of food, prepare it at the stove if needed, and serve the client. A new siren or a food slip can add further requirements before the service is finished.
u5: A client is waiting to be served and the siren is ringing, so both requirements are pending. No fallen food needs immediate recovery. The agent can handle either requirement first: silencing the siren leaves the client, while serving the client leaves the siren; both must eventually be completed. If food slips while both are pending, that immediate pickup becomes an additional requirement.
u6: Food has slipped and a client is waiting to be served. The next step must be the pickup of the fallen food; missing that step fails the task. After recovery, the agent must still satisfy the waiting client's order and serve them.
u7: Food has slipped, a client is waiting, and the siren is ringing — all three requirements are active. The very next step must be the pickup of the fallen food, or the task fails. After the pickup, the agent must still serve the waiting client and, if the siren is still ringing, switch it off; these can be done in either order.
u8: A mandatory requirement has been broken for good: the food fell and was not picked up on the very next step. This is a permanent failure, so successful completion is no longer possible no matter what else the agent does.
